title: Gridlock
description: A client-side modpack for Minecraft Gridlock esport.
body:
# Gridlock Approved Client Modpack

Gridlock Approved Client Modpack is a lightweight, tournament-safe client-side modpack made for players competing in or practicing for Gridlock, the 2v2 Minecraft bingo tournament format.

Gridlock is a competitive Minecraft mode where two teams of two race to complete objectives on a shared bingo board. Once a team completes a square, that objective is locked away from the opposing team, making speed, routing, awareness, and clean performance extremely important.

This modpack does not add new blocks, items, mobs, mechanics, abilities, or gameplay advantages. Instead, it provides a clean approved client setup focused on performance, stability, and tournament compliance.

## What this modpack includes

This pack contains only permitted client-side mods intended for:

* FPS improvement and smoother gameplay
* Reduced stuttering and better frame pacing
* Client stability during long matches
* Visual clarity without adding unfair information
* A consistent setup for Gridlock practice and tournament play

## What this modpack does not include

This pack does not include cheats, automation, x-ray, minimaps, entity tracking, unfair overlays, macros, gameplay-changing mods, or anything intended to give players information or abilities outside the allowed Gridlock ruleset.

## Why use this modpack?

Gridlock matches are fast and decision-heavy, so players should not have to waste time checking whether every individual optimization mod is allowed. This pack gives players a simple, ready-to-install client setup using only approved mods, helping them focus on routing, teamwork, mechanics, and match performance.

It is especially useful for:

* Gridlock competitors
* Practice partners
* Players who want a clean tournament-safe setup
* Anyone who wants better Minecraft performance without gameplay-changing features

## Important note

This modpack is an approved client-side setup for Gridlock play. It is not an official Mojang or Microsoft product and does not claim affiliation with Mojang or Microsoft.
